title: Bulk Data Operational Hardening — Idempotency, Validation Gate, Reconciliation
requirements: Add retry-safe client request idempotency for committed bulk operations without new tables.
Require clean preflight validation before UI commit action and invalidate validation when dataset/mode/file changes.
Strengthen CSV header/template checks and surface missing or unexpected headers before server execution.
Add admin-only business-key reconciliation for CUSTOMER, CARRIER, RATE and BOOKING plus downloadable CSV reconciliation report.
Keep 1000-row maximum and prove boundary behavior.
Preserve existing batch history, audit, privacy and atomic rollback behavior.
invariants: No database migration or new table.
Preserve CR-010 and CR-011 role/privacy/security controls.
No production deployment, DNS change, live providers or real money.
note: Autonomous staging-only continuation. Safe in-scope fixes may be applied and retested without intermediate approval.
